result_rows.shape: Sticky rows for (workspace slug, owner) only; other owners' rows in the same workspace excluded; other workspaces excluded

get_queryset.rule: super().get_queryset() (= model.objects.all(), soft-delete filtered) .filter(workspace__slug=slug).filter(owner_id=user.id).distinct(), then filter_queryset backends loop
get_queryset.sql: SELECT DISTINCT <stickies cols> FROM "stickies" INNER JOIN "workspaces" ON ("stickies"."workspace_id" = "workspaces"."id") WHERE ("stickies"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "workspaces"."slug" = %s AND "stickies"."owner_id" = %s);

result_rows.empty_query: query='' / absent -> no icontains predicate (falsy guard: request.query_params.get('query', False))

list_ordering_and_search.rule: order_by('-created_at'); if query truthy: filter(description_stripped__icontains=query); paginate default_per_page=20
list_ordering_and_search.sql: SELECT DISTINCT <stickies cols> FROM "stickies" INNER JOIN "workspaces" ON (...) WHERE (... AND UPPER("stickies"."description_stripped"::text) LIKE UPPER(%s)) ORDER BY "stickies"."created_at" DESC;  -- %s = %query% (icontains); NULL description_stripped rows never match
